cases.title: The scan is clear. The person is stuck.
cases.impact: The email field works, but Tab never reaches the mouse-only account action. The person can enter their details and still cannot submit this keyboard task.
cases.explanation: Tabstitch checks what happened to the person’s interaction, then replays the same task after the source repair. The receipt and submitted input must still match.

cases.title: A reachable button. A broken result.
cases.impact: The replacement button can now be activated with the keyboard. But its confirmation changes to “Wrong account”. Calling that a successful repair would hide a functional regression.
cases.explanation: The repair gate rejects the candidate because the original functional contract fails. Better keyboard behavior alone cannot authorize a broken application.

cases.title: The dialog closes. Focus is left behind.
cases.impact: After Escape hides an opacity-based dialog, focus is pulled back into invisible content. The page looks ready; the keyboard user has lost their place.
cases.explanation: This historical a11y-dialog change removes the focus listeners before restoring the opener. We reproduced the original failure and replayed the published human fix on the same task.
